# Recall

> Recall is a personal AI encyclopedia that summarizes and organizes content from multiple sources, helping users build a searchable knowledge base without forgetting important information.

Recall integrates with popular platforms like YouTube, Google Docs, Chrome, and Firefox to capture and summarize content. The platform uses AI-powered knowledge graphs and spaced repetition to help users retain and retrieve information effectively.

## Key Topics

- Knowledge Management
- Personal Knowledge Base
- AI Summarization
- Knowledge Graph
- Graph View 2.0
- Spaced Repetition
- Content Organization
- Chrome Extension
- YouTube Integration
- Google Docs Integration
- Augmented Browsing
- Quiz 2.0
- Local-First Security
- GDPR Compliance
- Student Discount
